targets.rawQueryText: SELECT matrix, hunter, SUM(result = 'WIN') AS wins, SUM(result = 'LOSS') AS losses, SUM(result = 'UNKNOWN') AS "no dollar pnl", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(result = 'WIN') / NULLIF(SUM(result IN ('WIN', 'LOSS')), 0), 1) AS "win %", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd), 0), 2) AS "realized usd", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN result = 'WIN' THEN pnl_usd END), 2) AS "avg win", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN result = 'LOSS' THEN pnl_usd END), 2) AS "avg loss", SUM(result != 'UNKNOWN') AS closes FROM trade_closes WHERE unix_s >= $__from / 1000 AND unix_s < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY matrix, hunter ORDER BY "realized usd" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT matrix, hunter, SUM(result = 'WIN') AS wins, SUM(result = 'LOSS') AS losses, SUM(result = 'UNKNOWN') AS "no dollar pnl", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(result = 'WIN') / NULLIF(SUM(result IN ('WIN', 'LOSS')), 0), 1) AS "win %", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd), 0), 2) AS "realized usd", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN result = 'WIN' THEN pnl_usd END), 2) AS "avg win", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN result = 'LOSS' THEN pnl_usd END), 2) AS "avg loss", SUM(result != 'UNKNOWN') AS closes FROM trade_closes WHERE unix_s >= $__from / 1000 AND unix_s < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY matrix, hunter ORDER BY "realized usd" DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT matrix || ' ' || hunter AS hunter, SUM(result = 'WIN') AS wins, SUM(result = 'LOSS') AS losses FROM trade_closes WHERE unix_s >= $__from / 1000 AND unix_s < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY matrix, hunter ORDER BY wins + losses DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT unix_s AS time, matrix || ' ' || hunter AS hunter, ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY matrix_id, bot_id ORDER BY unix_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), 2) AS realized FROM trade_closes WHERE result != 'UNKNOWN' AND unix_s >= $__from / 1000 AND unix_s < $__to / 1000 ORDER BY unix_s
